verdict.rationale: Pipedream MCP is a SaaS integration platform, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis, but the evidence pack documents no retention settings, retention periods, or data-deletion capability. The nearest items are revoking connected-account access and encryption of credentials at rest, which are adjacent access and security controls, not control over how long data is kept or how it is deleted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
